approaches.title: Sorted array with two pointers
approaches.summary: Sorts the numbers, then fixes one value and uses left and right pointers to search for complementary pairs. The initial version attempts deduplication with a set, while the revision correctly bounds the fixed index and skips duplicates in-place.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduces a sorted-array two-pointer search with a hash set for deduplication. Marked wrong; it has incorrect indexing and set usage, and stops after the first match for each fixed value.
Corrects the fixed index and pointer bounds, removes the hash set, and skips duplicate values directly after sorting. Reports O(n^2) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
